landing.kicker: For anyone about to sign something
landing.intro: Drop in a lease, a loan, a job offer or an app’s terms. ClauseClear explains each clause in plain language, marks the ones that could cost you, and quotes the exact line so you can check us.
landing.privacyNotice: Redact names, addresses and ID numbers before you upload. We don’t keep your document, but its text is sent to an AI service to be read, and free AI services may use what they receive to improve their models.
landing.scope: Detailed checks for rental, job, loan and terms-of-service documents. Other documents get a general reading.
landing.tryLabel: No document handy? Try a sample:
landing.heroFlagTitle: Could keep you out of your own field for two years
landing.heroFlagText: After you leave, you couldn’t work for a competitor for 24 months. Ask what counts as a competitor, and whether the period can be shorter.
landing.feedNote: Works best on text PDFs in English for now. Scans and other languages are on the list.
landing.step1Text: Upload a PDF or paste the text. We work out what kind of document it is.
landing.step2Text: Every clause gets a plain-language reading. The risky ones get flagged, with the exact line quoted next to them.
landing.step3Text: You get questions to put to the other side, plus a checklist for before and after you sign.
landing.checkTitle: A checklist made from your own flags
landing.checkText: What to sort out before you sign and what to do afterwards. Each item says which flag it came from.
landing.checkItem1: Get the refund date in writing
landing.checkItem2: Ask who pays if it ends early
landing.glossTitle: Legal words, explained in the margin
landing.glossText: Hover, tap or tab to a dotted word and its plain meaning shows up right there.
landing.glossTipDef: To cover someone else’s losses. Here, if the company is sued over something you did, you may have to pay for it.
landing.smallPrintLabel: The small print about our small print
landing.clause41: We don’t keep your document. We read it, answer, and delete it from our server.
landing.clause42: To read it, we send the text to an AI service. Free services may use inputs to improve their models, so redact anything personal first.
landing.clause43: Every flag quotes your document. If we can’t find the line, there is no flag.
landing.clause44: We are not lawyers. ClauseClear helps you read and ask better questions. It is not legal advice. For anything high-risk, talk to a lawyer.
landing.pasteLabel: Paste the text of your document
landing.slow: Free servers can be slow. Still working.
landing.resultGone: Your result isn’t stored, so it can’t be reopened. Upload again or try a sample.
landing.heroClause8: The Employee shall keep all business information of the Company confidential during and after employment.
landing.heroClause9Quote: For a period of 24 (twenty-four) months after leaving, the Employee shall not work for any business that competes with the Company.
landing.heroClause10: 10. NOTICE. Either party may end employment by giving 30 days’ written notice.
landing.glossClauseAfter: the Company against any claims arising from your use of the Service.
landing.dropActive: Drop the PDF to check it
landing.pasteHint: Between {min} and {max} characters. Copy the whole document if you can.

results.speechNoVoice: Read aloud needs a voice for this language, and none is installed.
results.questionsHeading: Questions to ask before you sign
results.disclaimer: This is a plain-language reading to help you ask better questions. It is not legal advice and it is not a complete review. For high-risk results, talk to a lawyer.
results.docHint: Pick a flag to jump to its clause
results.translateFailed: The Hindi translation didn’t work, so this result stays in English.
results.empty: We didn’t find anything to flag. That doesn’t mean the document is safe.
results.warningPartial: We couldn’t find the exact line for some flags in your document, so we left them out. Every flag shown here quotes your document.
results.warningLowType: We weren’t sure what kind of document this is. If “{type}” is wrong, some checks may not fit.
results.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
results.rerun: Check it again as this type
results.rerunNote: Your document goes to the AI service again, with the type you chose.

checklist.intro: Tick things off as you go. The tag on each item says which flag raised it.
checklist.basedOn: Built from {file}. A different document gives a different list.
checklist.footnote: Not legal advice. Requirements such as registration and tenant verification vary by place, so check with your local authority or a lawyer.

status.offline: You’re offline. What’s on screen stays here. Checking a document or switching to Hindi needs a connection.

notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped. Results aren’t stored, so a link can’t bring one back.

errors.BAD_REQUEST: We didn’t get a file or any text. Choose a PDF, or paste the text.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find that. Go back and try a sample from the list.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is over {mb} MB. Try a smaller PDF, or paste the text instead.
errors.NOT_PDF: This file isn’t a PDF. Choose a PDF, or paste the text instead.
errors.PDF_ENCRYPTED: This PDF is password-protected, so we can’t read it. Remove the password, or paste the text instead.
errors.TOO_MANY_PAGES: This PDF has more than {pages} pages. Upload the part you need, or paste the text instead.
errors.NO_TEXT: We couldn’t find any text in this PDF. It may be a scan. Paste the text instead.
errors.TEXT_TOO_SHORT: That’s under {min} characters, too short to read as a document. Paste the whole text.
errors.TEXT_TOO_LONG: That’s over {max} characters. Paste the part you want checked, up to {max} characters.
errors.NOT_LEGAL: This doesn’t look like a legal document. Try a lease, a loan, a job offer or an app’s terms.
errors.NOT_ENGLISH: We can only read English documents for now. If yours has a Hindi part, paste only the English part.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many documents are being checked right now. Try again in {n} seconds, or open a sample.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The AI service isn’t answering right now. Try again in a moment, or open a sample.
errors.ANALYSIS_FAILED: Something went wrong while reading this document. Try again, or paste the text instead.
errors.CANCELLED: Stopped. Nothing was kept. You can start again.
